# AI brief — Monday 05 October 2026

## The day

The sharpest line in AI policy today is between Altman and Amodei: Altman told an audience the world must accept some harms as the price of AI's benefits, while Amodei—fresh from a dinner that may be shifting Trump's stance—pushed for stronger regulation. That split is substantive, not rhetorical, and it's playing out simultaneously before regulators and the public. Separately, OpenAI shipped a visual ad format inside ChatGPT with new measurement and attribution tools, moving the monetization model a concrete step forward.

- 87 items pulled from 9 feeds in the last 30 hours
- 85 of those are about AI at all (2 matched no AI term as a whole word)
